name: cut2_a
ref_note: Image 1 is the first-round design the owner CHOSE: keep its idea (LEFT a thin jagged crack line, RIGHT the same cut ripped open into a narrow jagged gash with two cream paper lips, an ink-dark gap and a small curled flap at each end) but draw it MUCH bolder and clearer as described below: the first version was too thin and too quiet. Image 2 is an approved effect sticker of our game: use its thick, confident ink line weight and flat cream colouring as the minimum. Do NOT draw a cat or a sword.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mobile game skill-effect sticker sheet, each piece shown about 70 px long
Subject: TWO separate effect stickers side by side in a strict grid of 2 columns by 1 row, one centred in each cell, each drawn perfectly HORIZONTAL (left to right) so a game can rotate it. They are stuck on top of enemy characters of ANY colour (pale, cream, green, orange and also very dark purple or navy) to show a sword cut, so they must read clearly on both light and dark: a playful PAPER CUT, like a slit torn in a sticker, never bloody. Common rules: a VERY THICK dark brown-black ink outline (about three times as thick as in image 1, a bold sticker line), paper-cream (about #FFF3D6) lips with a deeper warm tan shadow tone (about #E7C58C) along their inner edges for contrast, and a deep ink-black-brown gap (about #20120C) with HARD contrast against the cream lips. LEFT cell = the cut LINE when the enemy has just been marked: a short jagged crack, about 7 times longer than thick, still bold (it must be a clear dark-outlined shape when shrunk to 56 pixels), with the ink gap showing as a thin dark core inside it. RIGHT cell = the same cut OPENED into a gash: a ripped slit about 3 times longer than high, tapering to a sharp point at both ends, only four or five BIG irregular jagged notches per lip (no regular teeth, not a mouth, not a zipper), a small torn flap curled back at each end. Emphasis A (bold and tidy): in BOTH cells, ONE small white-hot SPARK sits where the cut STARTS (at the left end): a flat four-point star with a white centre and pale-yellow points, about the height of the gash, with a thick ink outline, overlapping the left end of the cut a little. Nothing else around it.
Style: 2D cartoon sticker illustration with a thick outline (dark brown unless the subject says otherwise) and a clean white sticker border around each piece. MATTE finish: flat colours with at most one soft shadow tone per shape, NO glossy highlights, NO specular shine, NO strong gradients, NO rim light, NO sparkle or glitter effects, NO glow; slightly muted, natural colours (never neon). Simple large bold shapes that still read when shrunk to about 50 pixels. NO tiny dots, NO speckle, NO dense repeated pattern, NO fine detail. Cute and friendly, never scary or gross. Exception to the no-sparkle rule for this job only: the bright accent described below is wanted, drawn as FLAT hard-edged star shapes with a clean ink outline and flat fills (white and pale yellow), no glow, no blur, no glitter. 
Composition: each piece fully inside its own cell, filling about 70 percent of it, generous empty space around it, nothing touching another piece, a cell border or the image edge
Background: genuinely transparent background (alpha) outside the white sticker borders; no checkerboard pattern, no frame, no ground, no cast shadow.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, nothing cropped, nothing touching the image edge.
